subject: Topology and parameters for the T4 - Thyroxine

messages.author: Marcelo Andrade Chagas
messages.body:
Dear amber list
They could suggest alternatives for obtaining parameters
for the hormone thyroxine (T4)?
What alternative to take advantage of GAFF topology by generating T4.mol2
file and using RESP loads?
Is it possible to use antechamber and parmck with GAFF for this
parameterization?
My interest is in the topology and parameters for the T4.
Thank you in advance for future clarifications.

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Tue, May 12, 2020, Marcelo Andrade Chagas wrote:
>
>What alternative to take advantage of GAFF topology by generating T4.mol2
>file and using RESP loads?
>
>Is it possible to use antechamber and parmck with GAFF for this
>parameterization?
GAFF sounds like a natural here: ask for the gaff2 forcefield in both
the antehamber and the parmchk2 steps. See the sustiva tutorial for
how this is done:
https://ambermd.org/tutorials/basic/tutorial4b/index.html
...dac
